given: an organization designated for server operations, with an Administrator, a Supervisor, a Crew member and a Supply Officer
a synthetic SMTP relay that accepts TLS connections, one configured with a login and one that authenticates by the server's IP address
synthetic operator and deputy recipient addresses
a throwaway server with the host alert checks, the host-copy job and an outside reachability probe installed
when: the Administrator saves relay settings with a password, then with IP authentication and no password, and sends a test email
the Supervisor, Crew member and Supply Officer request the relay settings page and post a change directly
a plaintext SMTP setting is submitted
the host-copy job runs, then the application and database are stopped
each DEP-13 condition is induced in turn, held past the repeat interval, then cleared
then: only the Administrator can view or change the settings; the others are denied server-side
the password is never shown back, and the audit record names the changed fields without it
the plaintext setting is refused and nothing changes
the host copy is root-owned mode 0600, and alerts still send while the application and database are stopped
each alert reaches both recipients once when it starts and once when it clears, and repeats no sooner than 6 hours
alert text and alert logs contain no secrets
notes: Language-neutral contract for owner-approved SPEC amendment 4.2.0 (issue #8). The scenario is not yet bound to application commands.
